system.description:
Starting at 3rd level, you learn the Chakra Movement Ninjutsu. This does not count against your known jutsu limit. The Casting time of this jutsu becomes;

Special (When you would move at least 10 feet).

You also choose one of the following Jutsu; Wind Release: Zephyr Strike, Lighting Release: Lightning Speed, Graceful Cat, or Flower Petal Escape

You learn the selected jutsu which also does not count against your known jutsu limit. The selected jutsu can be cast by spending 1 superiority die, in place of chakra. If the jutsu would requires concentration, you can maintain it at no additional chakra cost.

You learn another jutsu from this list when you would reach 9th and 14th levels, all being able to cast with a superiority die as the first.

source.custom: Imported full source rules; contextual benefits require adjudication.

rules.text: You learn Chakra Movement (cast when you move at least 10 feet) and one of Zephyr Strike, Lightning Speed, Graceful Cat or Flower Petal Escape (another at 9th and 14th), not counting against jutsu known. They can be cast with 1 Superiority Die in place of chakra, and their concentration is free (pay the die at the table, in place of the cast's chakra).
